name: Big Game Hunter
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.

You have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
narrative.objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Bloody well done! Right-o! Congratulations, adventurer, for succeeding where others have failed.

I am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!

Cheers to you, I say! Cheers!
narrative.requestItemsText: I see you're back, old bloke. King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times. Hang in there.
